mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.store_phone_number, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.store_phone_number, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating,COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN menu m ON s.store_id = m.store_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE m.menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.address, s.store_phone_number, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE s.store_type = #{keyword} GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
select * from image_file where store_id = #{storeId} or review_id = (select review_id from reviews where store_id=#{storeId})
select menu_name, price, description, file_name from menu where store_id=#{storeId} order by display_no asc

select r.review_id, m.login_id as writerId, r.reservation_id, r.waiting_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at from reviews r inner join members m on r.member_id=m.member_id where store_id=#{storeId} order by r.created_at desc
select rating, count(rating) as countScoreRating from reviews where store_id=#{storeId} group by rating order by rating desc
